summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release for New Residential Construction in August 2022, issued September 20, 2022. Relevant to the task: Table 3a provides preliminary Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) data for Total Housing Starts (1,575,000) and Single-Family (1 unit) Starts (935,000) for August 2022.
